snippet.title: Demo Trailer | CaveVox
snippet.description:
CaveVox is a first-person roguelike set in a medieval fantasy dungeon. Level up, face traps, fight monsters and bosses. Each run is unique, with permadeath forcing tough choices as you delve deeper, crafting your own adventure.

▶ Game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3013050/CaveVox/
▶ Official Discord Server: https://discord.gg/YPqBB68w9N
